title: Rename email review option 'Only untrusted senders' to 'Manage per sender'
summary: The Payables Agent email review policy option 'Only untrusted senders' is renamed to 'Manage per sender' to better reflect its functionality.
key_points: Enum option caption changed from 'Only untrusted senders (recommended)' to 'Manage per sender (recommended)'
Affects the PA Email Review Policy enum in Payables Agent
Improves clarity of email review policy naming
